note: Real run on a live Meta ad account and the public Meta Ad Library, anonymised. The account calls ran on 2026-10-02: the account's name, campaigns, ad copy, calls to action and ids are withheld and its figures shown in bands. Because that copy would identify the account, the library half uses a neutral public niche instead: real pulls of Lindblad Expeditions' and Viking's public ads on 2026-10-04 through the InsightfulPipe CLI (asked with status ALL, so rows are kept to is_active, which is what the skill's default returns), and the copy is written from the example product brief in facts_given. Built from the raw responses; no number was typed by hand.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "meta-ad-copy-writer" skill. Find my best Meta ads and write five new primary texts and five headlines based on what's winning. Competitors: Lindblad Expeditions, Viking. Use only the facts below.
facts_given: Example Voyages runs small-ship expedition cruises in Alaska, Norway and Iceland.
Every ship carries naturalist guides who lead each day ashore.
Guests go ashore by kayak and Zodiac landings.
Groups are small, so the ship can stop where the wildlife is.
Guests can talk to a voyage planner who has sailed the route before they book.
No price, offer or deposit terms to mention.
data_pulled: get_insights_adaccount level=account, maximum (lifetime spend under $1, under 100 impressions)
get_ad_creatives_by_ad for 2 ads (both dynamic creative, 1 with a video asset)
query_contexts actions_details for create_ad_creative (call_to_action_type_values only; nothing created)
facebook_search_companies for 2 competitors (the Viking search returned 3 pages with the same name and like count)
facebook_company_ads for 3 pages; it found active ads for 2 of them
facebook_search_ads 'Viking Cruises' for the 1 page where facebook_company_ads found none, kept to rows with that page_id; it found 6 active rows, all catalog templates
